役割.逐語: In essence, we compare a realized return at any given time to a consistently estimated instantaneous volatility using corresponding local movements of returns. More speciﬁcally, the ratio of realized return to estimated volatility creates the test statistic for jumps.
This article introduces a new nonparametric test to detect jump arrival times and realized jump sizes in asset prices up to the intra-day level.
